neighbours.label: The token 'acoustic', across musical, physical, and word-mention contexts.
fire: At the small recital, Lena performed an acoustic arrangement of the song.
The workshop keeps an acoustic guitar beside the tuning bench.
Researchers measured the acoustic response of the empty tunnel.
A layer of acoustic insulation surrounds the rehearsal booth.
The submarine team studied acoustic signals reflected from the seabed.
Their new record includes an acoustic version of the opening track.
On the terminology card, acoustic was the only word underlined.
The designer chose acoustic as the sample word for the lettering exercise.
quiet: For the small recital, Lena arranged the song for unamplified instruments.
Beside the tuning bench, the workshop stores an electric guitar.
Inside the empty tunnel, researchers measured how sound waves were reflected.
The rehearsal booth is surrounded by a layer of soundproofing material.
The submarine team examined sound pulses returning from the seabed.
An unplugged version of the opening track appears on their new record.
Only the word electric was underlined on the terminology card.
For the lettering exercise, the designer selected resonant as the sample word.

notes: The positive pole is mostly a gate-closed echo and has a small maximum. Acoustic fired in both music and physics probes; the negative pole is strongly associated with audio. Audubon and data pieces also fire this pole and remain outside this token hypothesis.
